scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w @ritmo/api" "npm run dev -w @ritmo/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ritmo/api && npm run build -w @ritmo/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @ritmo/api && npm run test -w @ritmo/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @ritmo/api && npm run typecheck -w @ritmo/web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
